newsitem.title: USA: Lafarge sees $1.3 mln Q4 post-tax charge.
newsitem.headline: Lafarge sees $1.3 mln Q4 post-tax charge.

text.p: Lafarge Corp said on Tuesday it would incur a $1.3 million after tax, or $0.02 per diluted share, extraordinary charge in the fourth quarter, due to a debt redemption plan.

The cement and concrete producer said it called for redemption of all outstanding seven percent convertible subordinated debentures dated July 1, 1988. The redemption date was December 12, 1996, the company said.
All $100 million of the debentures issued were currently outstanding, Lafarge said.
The redemption price would be 101.4 percent of the principal amount of each $1,000 debenture plus interest accrued to the redemption date, Lafarge said.

Interest on the debentures would stop accruing on December 12, it said. Until then, debenture holders had the right to receive Lafarge common shares at a conversion price of $22.125 per share, the company said.
The company said about $0.8 million of the pre-tax $2.2 million charge was unamortized debt issuance cost.
Lafarge produces cement, concrete, aggregates and other construction products for residential, commercial, institutional and public works construction.
